entities.summary: Jan August Kisielewski was a Polish writer, essayist and playwright associated with the Young Poland literary movement at the turn of the century. Jan August Kisielewski was a poets & playwrights from Rzeszów (1876-02-08, Rzeszów–1918-01-29). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
